title: FiveM runtime debug MCP normative contract definitions
description: RFC attachment; not runtime implementation. Definitions for 10 tool inputs and structured outputs. Byte bounds, normalization and execution invariants are specified by runtime-debug-mcp-rfc.md.

resources.description: Visible resources and their states at read time.

ResourceRead.description: Exact resource names and current states captured on Host Tick.

state.description: Current lifecycle state; queued and running are not final results.

execution.description: Whether effects were not dispatched, ended or remain uncertain.

Task.description: Task state and execution evidence; an initial response may be unfinished, so query queue by taskId.

side.description: Log source side.

state.description: Collection state: available and partial permit client-only reads; other states do not.

reason.description: Human-readable collection limitation, or null when none.

gap.description: True when collected lines may be missing.

clientId.description: Exact game client whose source is described.

Coverage.description: Log source coverage; state and gap indicate incomplete collection.

clientId.description: Optional exact client ID used to filter the status result.

action.description: Queue operation: inspect status, cancel an undispatched task, or recover an uncertain task.

taskId.description: Exact task ID; required for cancel and recover.

statusOutput.description: Immediate server status snapshot with client bindings, dependencies, log coverage and queue state; failures carry an error.

queueOutput.description: Queue overview, one task, or recovery result according to action; failures carry an error.

execute_luaOutput.description: Submitted Lua task with execution state and possible result or error; queued and running tasks need a later queue query.

execute_jsOutput.description: Submitted JavaScript task with execution state and possible result or error; queued and running tasks need a later queue query.

resourceOutput.description: Resource list or status read, or a submitted change task; unfinished changes need a later queue query.

logsOutput.description: Matching log lines, separate source coverage and truncation state; failures carry an error.

esxOutput.description: Submitted ESX task with execution state and possible result or error; queued and running tasks need a later queue query.

qbcoreOutput.description: Submitted QBCore task with execution state and possible result or error; queued and running tasks need a later queue query.

oxOutput.description: Submitted ox task with execution state and possible result or error; queued and running tasks need a later queue query.

referenceOutput.description: Immediate reference search results with provenance; failures carry an error.
